summary: Iter12: Tested adaptive content generation (reading passages, writing prompts, portfolio, audio transcribe). Backend: 37/37 pytest cases pass in test_reading_writing.py covering passage shape + word count + 4-5 questions w/ literal/inferential/vocabulary types + 4 citation ids resolved, level resolution from Enzo profile (actual grade=5 not 3 as review_request stated), level_override below/above shifts grade_target by ±1, parent-only generation (student role gets 403, anon 401), submission accepted by both parent and student, other parent gets 403, persistence verified via GET (answers/feedback/score/completed_at), writing piece scaffold/starters/draft empty initially, empty draft returns 400, portfolio returns reading+writing arrays for owner parent and the student themselves (other parent 403, anon 401), audio/transcribe returns 400 on empty body / 413 on >24MB / 401 anonymous, plus regression smoke on /citations /skills /strategies /moments/catalog /games/catalog /public/stats /students/{id}/intake /missions. Frontend: 3 CTAs on About-Enzo card are wired (parent-generate-reading, parent-generate-writing, parent-open-portfolio). Generate API call succeeds (200 to /api/reading/passage seen in network) and window.open(/student/practice/reading/{id}) is invoked. BUT the new tab redirects to /parent immediately — confirmed by directly page.goto'ing the URL: no GET /api/reading/passage/{id} request fires, body renders the parent dashboard. ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/App.js imports ReadingPractice, WritingPractice, Portfolio but NEVER registers <Route> entries for /student/practice/reading/:passageId, /student/practice/writing/:pieceId, /parent/students/:studentId/portfolio. The catch-all '<Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />}/>' then bounces every visit back to /parent. This makes ALL 3 new pages completely inaccessible despite the backend being healthy and the dashboard buttons firing correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing <Route> registrations for ReadingPractice, WritingPractice, and Portfolio. Components are imported (lines 26-28) but never used in <Routes>. Result: navigating to /student/practice/reading/:id, /student/practice/writing/:id, or /parent/students/:id/portfolio falls through to the catch-all path='*' and redirects to /parent. All 3 new pages are unreachable.

integration_issues.issue: POST succeeds and window.open() fires, but the new tab cannot render the practice page because the route is not registered — user lands on /parent and never sees the passage they just generated.

action_items: Add 3 <Route> entries to /app/frontend/src/App.js BEFORE the catch-all '*': path='/student/practice/reading/:passageId' -> <ReadingPractice/>, path='/student/practice/writing/:pieceId' -> <WritingPractice/>, path='/parent/students/:studentId/portfolio' -> <Portfolio/>. The reading and writing routes need ProtectedRoute without a role restriction (since both parent AND student can access — backend already authz-checks). The portfolio route should be ProtectedRoute role='parent'.

After the route fix, re-run the playwright UI flow: generate reading -> answer all 4 questions -> verify reading-overall renders Score: X/Y; generate writing -> click a sentence starter (verify it appends to writing-textarea) -> type draft -> verify writing-feedback renders.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md or backend seed to clarify Enzo's actual grade — review_request says grade=3 but live profile is grade=5. Either is fine but they should match the docs.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: dead imports for ReadingPractice/WritingPractice/Portfolio with no Route registration. CI lint should be configured to flag unused imports — this would have been caught at build time.

ReadingPractice.useEffect calls navigate('/') on ANY GET failure including 401/404. A 401 in a brand-new tab (rare, since cookie is shared) would silently bounce the user. Consider a friendlier error UI instead of redirect.
/api/audio/transcribe: 422 on empty transcript leaks the model's silence to the user as a 422 vs 400. Consider a single 4xx contract for 'no usable audio'.

_resolve_reading_target ignores non-integer grade strings like 'K' silently (returns the base grade with no shift for below/above). Add explicit handling for K so below stays K (not crash) and above goes to '1st grade'.
ReadingFeedback.per_question is a list of plain dicts, not typed — Pydantic won't validate question_id/correct/feedback fields. Promote to a nested model so the OpenAPI schema documents it.
server.py is now ~2630 lines. Reading & Writing section added another ~250 lines to an already-overloaded module. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/reading_writing.py before next feature.

ParentDashboard.generatePractice silently alerts on failure but doesn't surface the in-flight 'generatingPractice' state to the user beyond disabling the button — no spinner. AI generation can take 3-8s; users may click again or assume nothing happened.
Portfolio.jsx has no pagination — to_list(500) backend limit will eventually clip. Add a 'load more' or server-side pagination before users accumulate >500 artifacts.
Sentence-starter chips append to draft but there is no undo if the user mistakenly clicks one — clicking a chip a second time should remove it, or there should be a delete-last-starter affordance.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is healthy — re-running test_reading_writing.py against live URL should still be 37/37. Critical frontend block: 3 missing <Route> entries in App.js. Once the main agent adds them, the playwright flow to verify is: login as parent -> click parent-generate-reading -> wait for new tab to load reading-practice-page -> fill all reading-q-input-i textareas -> click reading-submit -> wait for reading-overall (score) and reading-q-feedback-i; then click parent-generate-writing -> verify writing-prompt, writing-scaffold, writing-starter-0 clickable (appends to writing-textarea), type draft -> click writing-submit -> verify writing-feedback. Portfolio test: click parent-open-portfolio -> verify portfolio-page renders with portfolio-reading and portfolio-writing sections each having item children with UUIDs in testids. The pre-existing 3 audio test failures in test_moments_audio.py are still out-of-scope (unrelated to this iteration).
rca of the issue: Frontend route registration miss. The main agent created the 3 page components (ReadingPractice.jsx, WritingPractice.jsx, Portfolio.jsx) and added the import statements in App.js (lines 26-28) but forgot to add the corresponding <Route> JSX entries inside the <Routes> block. Because App.js ends with '<Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />}/>', any unknown URL — including the 3 brand-new paths — falls through to the catch-all and gets redirected to '/' which then sends a parent user to '/parent'. Reproduction: login as parent -> open https://<frontend>/student/practice/reading/<any-uuid> directly -> observe redirect to /parent and no GET /api/reading/passage/<uuid> request in network panel. Mitigation: add the 3 missing Route elements (see action_items #1). After fix, the entire end-to-end flow should work because the backend is fully functional (verified via 37 passing pytest cases including a full create->submit->GET round-trip for both reading and writing).
